title: REQ · Scene suite proves hover, click and missing-asset fallback with Phaser mocked via @game
summary: A suite asserts hover highlight, click activation and the BootScene fallback texture for missing assets, with Phaser mocked.
description: Context: SceneObject wires onHover/onClick; BootScene (frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) uses planPreload and resolveTextureKey with FALLBACK_KEY. Desired behavior: suite asserts these through @game with phaser mocked. Expected result: passes together with REQ-B suite. Why: confirms SG-5.6.2 areas 4-5.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visible object, when hover is true then false, then setHighlighted and setLabelVisible get true then false
Given a visible synced object, when click fires, then the listener receives objectId and available actions; a hidden object emits nothing
Given an asset id absent from the manifest, when resolveTextureKey runs, then it returns the fallback key
Given a scene referencing an unknown asset, when preload runs, then it is not loaded and the fallback texture is generated
technical_constraints: Mock 'phaser' and frontend runtime modules with vi.mock
